T2 the Delta L = 2 Majorana operator EXISTS in the root's own algebra: the weight 2 lambda_nu = [2.0, -2.0, 2.0, 2.0, 2.0] (norm^2 20.0) has an algebra weight space of dimension exactly 1, and it sits in Clifford grade 5 - the 5-form channel of Spin(10) (the 126-type object of the type-II seesaw), with no field outside the root. T3 the Majorana weight is NOT an SM singlet and the 10-Higgs cannot make it one: its X-charge is -6.000 and its Y-charge -1.000, and over all 160 vector weights (norm^2 4) the closest two-insertion neutralisation leaves a residual weight of norm 4.472 - the norm mismatch is exact (|2 lambda_nu| = 4.472 against 2 x 2 = 4), so the Delta L = 2 neutralisation must come from the grade-5 (126-type) channel itself, not from the Higgs of Section 11.5

T4 the parity theorem: the Clifford multiplication table maps grade g to grade g +- 2 only (exact on all 45 x 1024 entries: True), so every product of adjoint (grade-2) factors is EVEN-grade; the cumulative span S_k has dimensions [45, 126, 208, 291, 352, 407] with odd-grade content ['0.0e+00', '0.0e+00', '0.0e+00', '0.0e+00', '0.0e+00', '0.0e+00'] and content along the Majorana direction ['0.0e+00', '0.0e+00', '0.0e+00', '0.0e+00', '0.0e+00', '0.0e+00'], hence k* = None - the Delta L = 2 operator (grade 5, odd) is NEVER an adjoint composite

T5 the same obstruction for the Higgs: the vector-10 weight (norm^2 4) has a weight space of dimension 16 carried entirely by ODD Clifford grades [1, 3, 5, 7, 9], and it is reached at k = None, while the adjoint channel (grade 2, even) is at k = 1 by construction - the two odd channels of the ladder, the 10-Higgs and the 126-type Majorana operator, are matter-layer objects, not gauge-link composites; the fitted n_2step = 3 is therefore NOT a link-word length

status: THE DELTA L = 2 OPERATOR IS NOT A GAUGE-LINK COMPOSITE (O2). The operator exists inside the root: the weight 2 lambda_nu (norm^2 20.0) has a 1-dimensional algebra weight space sitting in Clifford grade 5 - the 126-type channel - with no field outside the root. But Clifford multiplication changes grade by +-2, so products of the 45 adjoint link factors are always EVEN-grade (exact on the whole table) and the span S_k (dims [45, 126, 208, 291, 352, 407]) never contains it: k* = None for every k, and the vector-10 Higgs weight (grades [1, 3, 5, 7, 9], all odd) is likewise unreachable (k = None). The ladder exponent n_2step = 3 is therefore NOT the length of an adjoint word: the seesaw operator belongs to the odd (matter) half of the Clifford module, and O2 stays open
